Ibis is a self-custody wallet for power users, focused on privacy and customization. All network services and external connections are disabled by default.
Open the options menu to configure Ibis to your liking.
Open the Wallet Management screen to enable Liquid support for your desired wallets.\n\n*Liquid can only be enabled on BIP39 wallets.
Open the Wallet Management screen to enable Spark support for your desired wallets.\n\n*Spark can only be enabled on BIP39 seed wallets.
Connect to a remote node (LND, CLN, or NWC) using the Configure node screen. Each node is added as its own wallet.
Open the Wallet Management screen to enable Ark support for your desired wallets.\n\n*Ark can only be enabled on BIP39 seed wallets.
